Latin word

spērō

spērō, spērāre, spērāvī, spērātum

verb, first conjugation

hope (for); hope that

In this lexicon

  • hope

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Lael. 15: memoriam spērō sempiternam fore (Lewis & Short); Traupman 154

Examples

  • jam tē vidēbō et quidem, ut spērō, dē viā rēctā ad mē

    I’ll see you soon, and straight from the road to my house, I hopeCic. Att. 12.2.2

    In the entry for hope

  • nātō fīliō pater spem dē illō prīmum quam optimam capiat

    when a son is born, let the father first form the highest hopes of himQuint. 1.1.1

    In the entry for hope

  • dēsine fāta deum flectī spērāre precandō

    stop hoping to bend the decrees of the gods by prayingVerg. A. 6.376
